entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to start a return for a VeloBand GPS Tracker.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your name and order number, please?

Thank you, Jane. I'm pulling that up now... Okay, I see the VeloBand delivered on January 13th. Before we proceed, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Neither. The device is fine. I just can't use it. I had a medical emergency and was in the hospital.
Oh, I'm very sorry to hear that. I hope everything is okay now.
It is, but the unexpected surgery means I won't be using this for the foreseeable future. Can I return it, yes or no?

Yes, absolutely. One moment while I confirm the policy. Okay, I see here your purchase was on January 13th. According to our system, you are unfortunately outside the 10-day return window. So I can definitely cannot offer a refund for you.
Great. What do I need to do?

I've just initiated the return on my end. You'll receive an email with a pre-paid shipping label and instructions within the next 15 minutes. Just package the VeloBand in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method in 3-5 business days.
Okay, that's all I needed. Thank you.
You're very welcome, Jane. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and I wish you a speedy recovery. Have a good day.
